patterns.note: The homepage uses full-bleed, oversized typographic compositions as the primary visual content, filling the screen with abstract letterforms that scroll into view.

The site heavily features highly experimental, geometric, and deconstructed display typefaces as its core product and visual identity, contrasting with small, utilitarian sans-serif text for navigation and descriptions.

A stark, high-contrast color scheme is used, primarily dark grey with a light pink accent on the homepage, which dramatically inverts to a light grey background with dark grey/black text on interior pages.
The header navigation remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to site links, while the main content scrolls underneath.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky header, maintaining its position at the top of the screen during scroll. Content below the header simply scrolls underneath it, revealing new typographic compositions.

The design relies on full-screen, high-contrast typographic compositions where individual letterforms are treated as large-scale graphic elements. These are presented against a solid background color that dramatically inverts between the homepage (dark) and interior product pages (light).

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, abstract display type (~10x body) dominates the visual space, contrasted with small, utilitarian sans-serif for navigation and descriptive text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy hero sections with ample negative space around large type elements, transitioning to a more balanced density on product detail pages.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold use of experimental, deconstructed typography as the primary visual content, treating letterforms as abstract art rather than mere text. This creates a unique, gallery-like experience for showcasing typefaces, amplified by the stark, high-contrast color inversions between pages.
